restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมเชิงดอย Cherngdoi Dental Clinic
text:
Great dental clinic that I've used several times. Fairly large with 4 separate operating chairs in their own rooms. The dentists themselves have always spoken good English on my three or  four visits there. Never had to wait long for the stipulated time of my appointment and everything is carried out with care and efficiency. Very reasonable prices and have recommended to friends visiting Doi Saket who have also been very happy with their service.
Highly recommended!

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมเชิงดอย Cherngdoi Dental Clinic
text: Recommended by the reception at Tao Harden.  I went to the clinic for my crown fell off and needs to be glue back, temporary.  Dr. Fai who can speak fluent English did it for me.  She is very patient and professional.  I’m very happy with the service. The charger is incredibly reasonable.
